summary.title: 3D Game Development with LWJGL 3
summary.one_liner: An online book that teaches the main concepts of writing a 3D game in Java using the LWJGL 3 library to access OpenGL.
keywords: how to write a 3d game in java
takeaways: LWJGL 3 is a Java library giving access to native APIs such as OpenGL, OpenAL and OpenCL.
The book aims to organize scattered information on writing 3D games with OpenGL into one structured resource.
Sample source code is available on GitHub, and the book's own source is also published there.
The book is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and the sample code under Apache 2.0.
summary.summary: This online book introduces the core concepts needed to write a 3D game in Java with the LWJGL 3 library, which wraps native APIs for graphics (OpenGL), audio (OpenAL) and parallel computing (OpenCL). The author explains that the goal was to gather and organize scattered, sometimes incomplete material on OpenGL game techniques into a structured book. The page itself is a landing page: it links to GitHub repositories for the samples and the book source, states licensing, and invites feedback. The chapter content is not visible in the text provided, so the specific topics covered are not listed here.
